fullText.simplified:
第三十八章、最后的机关

    石柱上有一个精美的铁盒，江杨伸出手，准备打开盒子。
    “别动！小心！”石文谦大声提醒着江杨，同时拉着简西往江杨的方向跑去。
    突然，整个圆形的地面开始旋转起来。石文谦和简西一个没站稳，重重地摔倒在地上。紧接着，地面又升起了四个小的石柱，它们分别在东南西北四个方向，两两相对。每个石柱上面都摆着一个黑白棋格的桌面。什么意思？这是什么意思？三个人都觉得天旋地转，找不准方向。突然，周围的墙壁上也开始不停地闪现明暗交错的星星。
    “星图，是星图！”简西大声地叫道。
    “墙壁是东方青龙、南方朱雀、西方白虎和北方玄武的四个星图区域，找到每个区域缺失的那个星宿图，然后移动棋盘上的棋子，把它摆出来。”简西用最简短的话解释道。
    “一共有二十八个星宿，也就是说每个区域应该有七个星宿，现在在闪着的是六个，我要知道缺失的是哪一个星宿？开什么玩笑？！我……我怎么记得？”石文谦觉得头晕眼花，他努力从地上爬起来，抓住其中一个石柱，然后盯着上面的棋盘看。
    江杨试图打开铁盒，但是根本打不开。他看看墙壁上闪现的星图，明白这就是最后的机关了。抓紧时间，破解机关才是眼前最重要的事，不然会面临什么样的危险谁都无法预测。地面在旋转，江杨东倒西歪地走到一根小石柱前，然后盯着东面的墙，开始观察这些星宿的明暗变化，分析缺失的是哪一星宿。
    “我这边应该是东方青龙，少的是角星。”江杨很快就分析出了答案。
    “我这边应该是西方白虎，少的是毕星。”简西也很快就分析出了答案。
    随着两个人棋子的移动，地面旋转的速度似乎降下来很多。石文谦明显没有两个人那么熟悉星图，他盯着南面的墙看了半天，还是没有头绪。接下来，江杨走到了石文谦的位置，准备帮他，简西也走到了他们的对面。
    “现在这边是北方玄武，少的是危星。”简西冷静地分析出答案。
    “这边是南方朱雀，少的是鬼星。”江杨站在石文谦旁边，也很快说出了答案。这时候，简西正好移动完棋子，抬头看向正对面的南方朱雀。她大声喊了一声：“别动！不是鬼星！”
fullText.traditional:
第三十八章、最後的機關

    石柱上有一個精美的鐵盒，江楊伸出手，準備打開盒子。
    “別動！小心！”石文謙大聲提醒著江楊，同時拉著簡西往江楊的方向跑去。
    突然，整個圓形的地面開始旋轉起來。石文謙和簡西一個沒站穩，重重地摔倒在地上。緊接著，地面又升起了四個小的石柱，它們分別在東南西北四個方向，兩兩相對。每個石柱上面都擺著一個黑白棋格的桌面。什麼意思？這是什麼意思？三個人都覺得天旋地轉，找不準方向。突然，周圍的牆壁上也開始不停地閃現明暗交錯的星星。
    “星圖，是星圖！”簡西大聲地叫道。
    “牆壁是東方青龍、南方朱雀、西方白虎和北方玄武的四個星圖區域，找到每個區域缺失的那個星宿圖，然後移動棋盤上的棋子，把它擺出來。”簡西用最簡短的話解釋道。
    “一共有二十八個星宿，也就是說每個區域應該有七個星宿，現在在閃著的是六個，我要知道缺失的是哪一個星宿？開什麼玩笑？！我……我怎麼記得？”石文謙覺得頭暈眼花，他努力從地上爬起來，抓住其中一個石柱，然後盯著上面的棋盤看。
    江楊試圖打開鐵盒，但是根本打不開。他看看牆壁上閃現的星圖，明白這就是最後的機關了。抓緊時間，破解機關才是眼前最重要的事，不然會面臨什麼樣的危險誰都無法預測。地面在旋轉，江楊東倒西歪地走到一根小石柱前，然後盯著東面的牆，開始觀察這些星宿的明暗變化，分析缺失的是哪一星宿。
    “我這邊應該是東方青龍，少的是角星。”江楊很快就分析出了答案。
    “我這邊應該是西方白虎，少的是畢星。”簡西也很快就分析出了答案。
    隨著兩個人棋子的移動，地面旋轉的速度似乎降下來很多。石文謙明顯沒有兩個人那麼熟悉星圖，他盯著南面的牆看了半天，還是沒有頭緒。接下來，江楊走到了石文謙的位置，準備幫他，簡西也走到了他們的對面。
    “現在這邊是北方玄武，少的是危星。”簡西冷靜地分析出答案。
    “這邊是南方朱雀，少的是鬼星。”江楊站在石文謙旁邊，也很快說出了答案。這時候，簡西正好移動完棋子，抬頭看向正對面的南方朱雀。她大聲喊了一聲：“別動！不是鬼星！”

sentences.pinyin: zhè biān shì nán fāng zhū què shǎo de shì guǐ xīng
sentences.english: “This side is the Vermilion Bird of the South. It’s missing the Ghost Mansion.”

sentences.simplified: 江杨站在石文谦旁边，也很快说出了答案。
sentences.traditional: 江楊站在石文謙旁邊，也很快說出了答案。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng yáng zhàn zài shí wén qiān páng biān yě hěn kuài shuō chū le dá àn
sentences.english: Jiang Yang stood next to Shi Wenqian and also gave the answer quickly.

sentences.simplified: 这时候，简西正好移动完棋子，
sentences.traditional: 這時候，簡西正好移動完棋子，
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou jiǎn xī zhèng hǎo yí dòng wán qí zǐ
sentences.english: At this moment, Jian Xi had just finished moving her chess piece.

sentences.simplified: 抬头看向正对面的南方朱雀。
sentences.traditional: 抬頭看向正對面的南方朱雀。
sentences.pinyin: tái tóu kàn xiàng zhèng duì miàn de nán fāng zhū què
sentences.english: She looked up at the Vermilion Bird of the South directly opposite her.

sentences.simplified: 她大声喊了一声：“别动！不是鬼星！”
sentences.traditional: 她大聲喊了一聲：“別動！不是鬼星！”
sentences.pinyin: tā dà shēng hǎn le yì shēng bié dòng bú shì guǐ xīng
sentences.english: She shouted loudly, “Don’t move! It’s not the Ghost Mansion!”

sentence_translations: Chapter 38: The Final Mechanism
There was a beautifully crafted iron box on the stone pillar. Jiang Yang reached out his hand, preparing to open the box.
“Don’t move! Be careful!” Shi Wenqian loudly warned Jiang Yang, while pulling Jian Xi along and running in Jiang Yang’s direction.
Suddenly, the entire circular-shaped ground began to spin.
Shi Wenqian and Jian Xi both lost their balance and fell heavily to the ground.
Immediately after, four small stone pillars rose from the ground.
They were in the east, south, west, and north directions respectively, facing each other in pairs.
Each stone pillar had a chessboard-patterned tabletop placed on top. What did this mean? What did this mean?
All three people felt as if the world was spinning, and they couldn’t find their directions.
Suddenly, the walls around them also began to constantly flicker with alternating bright and dim stars.
“Star chart, it’s a star chart!” Jian Xi shouted loudly.
“The walls are the Azure Dragon of the East, the Vermilion Bird of the South, ..
.. the White Tiger of the West, and the Black Tortoise of the North, the four regions of the star chart.
Find the missing mansion in each region, then move the pieces on the chessboard to recreate it.”
Jian Xi explained this in the most concise way possible.
“There are a total of 28 mansions, which means that each region should have seven mansions.
Right now, there are six that are flashing. I need to know which mansion is missing?
What kind of joke is this?! How … how am I meant to remember?”
Shi Wenqian felt dizzy and his vision was blurred.
He struggled to get up from the ground, grabbing one of the stone pillars and then fixing his gaze on the chessboard above.
Jiang Yang tried to open the iron box, but it wouldn’t open.
He looked at the star chart flashing on the wall and understood that this was the final mechanism.
He had to hurry. Solving the mechanism was the most important thing at the moment.
Otherwise, no one could predict the kind of danger they would face.
The ground was spinning. Jiang Yang staggered over to a small stone pillar.
Then, he stared at the wall to the east and began to observe the changes in the brightness of these mansions.
He analyzed which mansion was missing.
“On my side, this should be the Azure Dragon of the East. It’s missing the Horn Mansion,” Jiang Yang figured out the answer quickly.
“On my side, this should be the White Tiger of the West. It’s missing the Net Mansion,” Jian Xi also figured out the answer quickly.
As the two of them moved their chess pieces, the speed of the ground’s rotation seemed to decrease significantly.
Shi Wenqian clearly didn’t know the star charts as well as the other two.
He stared at the wall to the south for a long time, but he still hadn’t figured it out.
Next, Jiang Yang walked over to where Shi Wenqian was, ready to help him. Jian Xi also walked to the side opposite them.
“This side right now is the Black Tortoise of the North. It’s missing the Rooftop Mansion,” Jian Xi calmly figured out the answer.
“This side is the Vermilion Bird of the South. It’s missing the Ghost Mansion.”
Jiang Yang stood next to Shi Wenqian and also gave the answer quickly.
At this moment, Jian Xi had just finished moving her chess piece.
She looked up at the Vermilion Bird of the South directly opposite her.
She shouted loudly, “Don’t move! It’s not the Ghost Mansion!”
